description: This file defines a TypeScript schema for configuring Zalo accounts within a plugin-based openclaw project. It imports various schemas and utilitarian functions, then constructs a detailed schema object for Zalo account configuration settings, and finally exports a combined schema for multi-account channel configuration.

methods.name: buildCatchallMultiAccountChannelSchema
methods.description: A function to create a catch-all schema for multi-account channel configurations, extending the provided account schema.

methods.name: buildSecretInputSchema
methods.description: A function to create a schema for secret input fields in configuration.
